label: Boxplot with Outliers
description: One box per category with the outliers drawn as separate points and the specification limits as dashed lines.
howTo: Bind `series[0].data` to one row per category: `[min, Q1, median, Q3, max]` (already calculated, e.g. in SQL with percentile functions).
Bind `series[1].data` to the outliers as `[categoryIndex, value]` rows.
The limits are `series[0].markLine.data[n].yAxis`; bind them to the specification tags. `yAxis.min` / `max` are fixed so the limits stay visible.

label: Grouped Boxplot
description: Three series side by side in every category, with a legend.
howTo: Each series is one group: bind `series[n].data` to one row `[min, Q1, median, Q3, max]` per category of `xAxis.data`.
Boxes of different series are placed side by side automatically; `boxWidth` is `[min, max]` width per box.
Outlier points cannot be shifted to follow a group, so in a grouped boxplot either leave them out or draw them with the single-series example.
